angle: Where tree materials analyze one fitted tree, this demo constructs forest diversity live from a four-sample bootstrap drawn with replacement plus a random variable subset at every split, then evaluates accuracy by out-of-bag majority vote with no held-out set.
angle_detail: Study [01:17]-[04:10] first for the bootstrap dataset, the two-variables-per-split rule and the six-tree variety, then [06:03]-[08:13] for out-of-bag classification and the error proportion. The best split is assumed, never computed with any criterion, and four samples cannot support real accuracy claims, so do not generalize the demo numbers. Decision-tree basics are a stated prerequisite from [00:22], not taught here.
